From: Asha Varma <asha@clearvision.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ephemeral capacity request for Nov launch

Hi Dylan,

We have a marketing-driven push the week of Nov 8 where ClearVision expects a short, high-throughput window for our API callers — roughly 2.8x our current monthly run-rate concentrated over 72 hours. Our engineers estimate ~120M additional tokens across prompts+completions during the window.

Can Redwood provide a short-term capacity uplift (burst/surge) or a provisional quota for that timeframe? If you can outline pricing (per-token overrun vs. temporary top-up), and whether you offer a one-off discount for predictable short windows, that would help our procurement and budget teams.

Key asks:
- Can we be provisioned for an extra 3x headroom Nov 8–10?
- What are the uplift rates and any discounts for a single-event true-up?
- Timeline to enable — we need a response before EOD Nov 3 to finalize launch plans.

I can loop in procurement once we have a concrete plan. Attaching a short usage extract for context.

Thanks,
Asha Varma
Head of Platform
ClearVision AI
(attachment: usage-snapshot-Nov.csv)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ephemeral capacity request for Nov launch

Hi Asha — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. We can help. Two quick notes up front:

Option A — Provisional top-up (short-term capacity):
- Add a provisional headroom pool for Nov 8–10 that sits above your committed quota.
- Activation: ~24 hours if we have a signed SOW/PO; we can do expedited provisioning in <12 hours with a phone confirmation.
- Pricing: blended provisional rate that is ~1.6x your standard pay-as-you-go unit price for the burst period.

Option B — Overrun true-up (post-event settlement):
- Let the traffic flow; we bill overruns on your existing contract at an overrun multiplier.
- Typical overrun multiplier: 2.0x unit rate; we can discuss a discount if you take a one-time true-up commitment.

To evaluate a discount I need a short run-of-show: token shape (peak QPS, expected sustained QPS, and total tokens). I’ve attached a small template (usage-estimate.xlsx) — if you can fill the peak and sustained QPS it’ll help Karthik size the staging and Marissa price the concession.

Cc'ing Karthik for technical sizing and Marissa for commercial. If you want, we can do a 20-min call tomorrow to lock the path.

—Dylan

Karthik — can you confirm staging time and any runway constraints (KV cache warp, burst warm pools)?

Quick tech check: we can stage a warm pool and pre-warm KV caches; provisioning can be done within 8–12 hours if we push the request today. We recommend the provisional top-up route to avoid throttles and degraded latency during the campaign.

From a cost perspective, the staging and pre-warm carries incremental infra cost (~$1.2k–$1.8k) depending on GPU mix. If commercial wants to offer a discount, finance should sign off on margin floor.

Marissa — can you propose a commercial concession? I flagged a 15–25% discount band as feasible for a one-time event, but anything >20% will need VP approval. Grace, tagging you for quick margin check — what's the lowest overrun multiplier we can accept for a single event true-up?

K.

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Ephemeral capacity request for Nov launch — pricing ask

Thanks for the context. Finance will approve a constrained concession:
- Overrun true-up multiplier: default 2.0x unit rate. We can offer 15% off that multiplier for this single event (so 1.7x effective multiplier) provided ClearVision executes the attached SOW and confirms a PO within 48 hours of proposal.
- One-time complimentary provisional headroom: up to 15M tokens free during the Nov 8–10 window (to cover initial ramp). Anything beyond that consumes the provisional pool rate (1.6x) or the overrun multiplier if they choose true-up.
- Rationale: caps our exposure while providing good faith smoothing for the customer.

Attached a draft SOW (SOW-ephemeral-burst-draft.pdf) and a short summary sheet. If Marketing/Sales wants a deeper concession we need VP approval.

- Grace
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Temporary capacity + single-event true-up — proposal (ClearVision)

Hi Asha — thanks for the patience. Based on your estimate and internal sizing, here is our proposed path for Nov 8–10:

Summary of options (pick A or B):

A) Provisional top-up (recommended)
- Provision: 3x headroom pool for Nov 8–10.
- Complimentary credit: first 15,000,000 tokens free to smooth initial ramp.
- Provisional unit rate (for additional provisional tokens): 1.6x your standard unit price.
- Activation: signed SOW + PO — standard provisioning time ~24 hours; we can expedite to <12 hours with confirmation.
- Outcome: predictable latency and no throttles during peak.

B) Overrun true-up (post-event settlement)
- Let burst run on existing quota; we bill overruns at effective multiplier 1.7x (finance-approved concession from default 2.0x).
- Requires SOW and PO to be on file within 48 hours of proposal to lock the concession.

Attachments: SOW-ephemeral-burst-draft.pdf, usage-estimate.xlsx (filled partially with your snapshot), usage-snapshot-Nov.csv

Next steps if you want to proceed:
1) Reply confirming which option you prefer.
2) I’ll send a final SOW and a short PO template for procurement.
3) Karthik will kick off provisioning if you pick A.

We aimed to balance predictability for ClearVision with a capped revenue exposure for Redwood — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to review.

Best,
